title: Why Drivers Started Filming The Road
sources: Insurance Information Institute: Staged Auto Accidents and Fraud Statistics
National Insurance Crime Bureau: Swoop and Squat Schemes

lines.text: Have you ever wondered why drivers put cameras on their dashboard?
It started with staged crashes on busy highways.
A car cuts in front, slams the brakes, while a truck blocks you beside you.
Then a fake victim dives straight onto your hood screaming he got hit.
Without witnesses, drivers were blamed for millions in fraudulent claims.
Until everyone started mounting wide-angle dashcams behind the mirror.
Now, the moment a fraudster demands thousands for a fake dent on his car,
the driver taps the screen, points to the red recording light,
and the scammer realizes he just filmed his own arrest.
